confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of southern Sri Lankan beach-town prices, not live listings or inspected price pages. Restaurant anchors (meals, coffee, beer) are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely with season and monsoon-period demand on the southwest coast in July. Sri Lanka rarely sells true draft beer, so beer is anchored to a standard 330 ml bottled domestic lager served in a restaurant. Cocktail and wine were set from the local price relationship to beer because direct knowledge is weaker; wine is the least certain of these. Hostel and hotel anchors are the widest ranges, with 3-star pricing most sensitive to peak-season and holiday demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on comparable tourist beach towns on Sri Lanka's southern coast (Galle, Mirissa, Hikkaduwa) and general Sri Lankan price levels for tourist-facing restaurants and registered guesthouses; no single named comparable city was used.
